 Gold rate today in Chennai, November 4: Know 22 karat, 24 karat and 18 karat rates before your Dhanteras, Diwali buy
 By Upstox News Desk 2 min read | Updated on November 04, 2026, 17:51 IST
 Preferred news source Select Upstox as your Preferred news source SUMMARY
 Chennai's 24 karat gold is ₹13,980 a gram, 22 karat ₹12,816 and 18 karat ₹10,485 today. With Dhanteras on November 6, showrooms are taking advance bookings.
 Gold rates have increased in the lead up to Diwali, Dhanteras. | Image: Shutterstock
 Chennai's gold rate stood at ₹13,980 per gram for 24 karat on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, with 22 karat at ₹12,816 and 18 karat at ₹10,485, according to Upstox's latest listing, which was last revised on November 4, at the time of writing. 
 Open FREE Demat Account within minutes! Join now 
 In the units most families here buy in, 10 grams of 24 karat costs ₹1,39,800, 22 karat ₹1,28,160 and 18 karat ₹1,04,850, the last worked out at 75% purity.
 Purity Rate per gram Rate per 10 g Change from Nov 3 (per 10 gram) 
 24K (999) ₹13,980 ₹1,39,800 +₹270 (+0.19%) 
 22K (916) ₹12,816 ₹1,28,160 +₹250 (+0.20%) 
 18K (750) ₹10,485 ₹1,04,850 +₹200 (+0.19%) 
 Gold rates in Chennai on November 4, 2026; indicative, before making charges and GST 
 Dhanteras falls on Friday, November 6, and Diwali on Sunday, November 8. Wednesday's session added ₹270 per 10 grams to 24 karat and ₹250 to 22 karat, after a 3.51% slide on October 31 that knocked ₹5,060 off every 10 grams of 24 karat gold.
 From October's high of ₹1,51,570, the metal is still down close to ₹12,000 per 10 grams.
 Tamil Nadu buyers lean on 22 karat for temple jewellery and heavy bridal work, where the alloy keeps large pieces wearable, while 18 karat dominates diamond-studded and light daily-wear designs.
 An 18 karat purchase costs roughly a quarter less per gram than 24 karat, which is why studded collections move fastest when prices are high.
 Please note the above rates are indicative and a specific store's quote may differ. So compare rates across shops on your own before deciding. The final bill will also exceed the karat price once making charges and 3% GST are added. For instance, a 10-gram 22 karat piece with 10% making charges attracts GST of ₹4,229, taking the total to about ₹1,45,205.
